title: Standby probationary readiness & prefetch harness for multi-region failover
creator: Maya Chen
description: Build a probationary readiness and prefetch harness to validate warm-standby nodes before they accept production traffic during multi-region failover. The harness will exercise model variants, KV cache priming, and a dual-handoff handshake to ensure the standby meets latency and quality SLOs. This ticket scopes the orchestration steps, probe definitions, scoring, and integration with the routing decision engine so that route promotion can be automated or gated by a readiness score.
acceptance_criteria: Define a probationary readiness score (0-100) that combines KV cache hit-rate, model-variant output fidelity, and latency p95 against a synthetic request profile
Implement prefetch probes that prime KV caches and validate cache consistency tokens on standby nodes
Wire the readiness score into smart routing: region promotion only occurs if readiness >= 85 for 3 consecutive probe windows
Create a canary runbook and dashboard showing probe results, score history, and decision traces
End-to-end test demonstrating automated promotion and rollback using the new harness in our staging multi-region cluster
notes: 2026-02-20: Triage - incident after last outage showed cold KV caches caused 6-9s tail latency during region takeover. This ticket proposed to preheat caches and introduce a gating score.
2026-02-24: Design review with SRE and Runtime teams. Agreed on three probe types: KV-prefetch, model-variant smoke, and latency microbenchmarks. Lukas to own orchestration glue.

2026-02-28: Prototype implemented: KV prefetch uses sampling of 500 keys from recent traffic, model smoke uses 50 golden prompts per model-variant. Initial scoring formula: 40% KV-hit, 40% model-fidelity, 20% latency headroom.

2026-03-03: Load-testing in staging (region B warm standby). Prefetch decreased p99 during takeover from 8.2s -> 1.4s on average for served prompts. Model-fidelity regression observed on quantized variant vQ1 (3% increase in hallucination on test set).
2026-03-06: Decision - block automatic promotion for model variants with fidelity >2% regression. Add automatic fallback mapping to higher-fidelity variants owned by the model-onboarding team.
2026-03-08: PR opened for orchestration controller: github.com/redwood-inference/region-orchestrator/pull/2345 (Lukas). Awaiting infra review for runtime>=1.22 compatibility.
2026-03-10: Tests added to the runbook and dashboard panels. Need product review on customer-visible behavior and opt-in config for Dedicated customers.
tasks: Instrument KV-prefetcher to accept sampled key sets and return consistency token
Implement model-variant smoke harness with configurable golden prompt sets per model
Extend routing engine API to consume readiness score and decision trace
Add dashboard panels and SLO alerts for probationary windows
Write end-to-end staging test and runbook steps for canary promotion and rollback
decisions: Use probabilistic sampling of 500 keys from rolling 6-hour traffic for KV prefetch (avoids needing full dataset).
Readiness threshold set to 85 for automatic promotion; between 70-85 triggers manual review; below 70 fails promotion.
Model variants with fidelity regressions >2% are excluded from promotion and mapped to fallback variants automatically.
Prefetch will run in parallel with lightweight model smoke tests and will consider a tokenized KV-consistency handshake to validate last-write visibility.
rollback_plan: If post-promotion metrics cross SLO thresholds (latency p95 > SLO or error-rate > 1.5x baseline) within 10 minutes, trigger automated rollback: demote region, re-route traffic to primary, and mark standby as quarantined for offline investigation. Playbook includes commands for forcing immediate cache rewarm and manual variant swap.
